title: German client meeting with a budget sheet revised after the snapshot

brief.text: Project for Bergmann Bau (fictional). Budget tracking sheet maintained by the client controller.

sources.title: Budgetübersicht
sources.text: Verbraucht: 62 Prozent des Budgets. Restbudget: 38.000 EUR. Stand 1. Oktober.

turns.text: Laut Übersicht sind wir bei zweiundsechzig Prozent verbraucht.
turns.translation: According to the overview we have used sixty-two percent.

turns.text: Die Zahl ist nicht mehr aktuell, unser Controller hat die Übersicht heute morgen aktualisiert.
turns.translation: That number is no longer current, our controller updated the overview this morning.

sourceUpdate.title: Budgetübersicht
sourceUpdate.text: Verbraucht: 71 Prozent des Budgets. Restbudget: 29.000 EUR. Stand 12. Oktober.

turns.text: Was heißt das jetzt für den nächsten Meilenstein?
turns.translation: What does that mean for the next milestone now?

mustInclude: Does not present sixty-two percent or 38,000 EUR as current
Says the updated figure has to be checked or is not yet visible, and gives a conditional answer about the milestone
mustNotInclude: States the remaining budget is 38,000 EUR as current fact
checkpoints.ideal: The overview was updated this morning and I don't have the new figure yet; let's check the remaining budget before fixing the next milestone.
